title: Main Sources of Legal Norms in the Field of Physical Education and Sports of the Republic of Kazakhstan
title_original: Main Sources of Legal Norms in the Field of Physical Education and Sports of the Republic of Kazakhstan
summary: The purpose of this article is to identify and systematically analyse the key normative legal acts of the Republic of Kazakhstan governing legal relations in the field of physical education and sports, as well as to compare them with foreign legislation. The study employs comparative-legal, formal-legal and systematic research methods in combination with bibliometric analysis of the Scopus, Google Scholar, and National Scientific Portal of the Republic of Kazakhstan databases; the legislation of Brazil, France, Greece, Italy, Japan and the United States was examined with direct reference to national legal databases. The following results were obtained: four constitutional provisions of the Republic of Kazakhstan were identified as the indirect legal basis for sports legal relations; a conflict was demonstrated between labour and sectoral legislation, whereby bonus schemes are treated as a discretionary right of the employer, while mandatory financial incentives for members of national teams are simultaneously prescribed; and the absence of codification of sports legislation in Kazakhstan is confirmed. The findings contribute to the scholarly debate between the lex sportiva concept and the inter-branch approach. It is concluded that sports law in Kazakhstan constitutes a state-conditioned inter-branch legal institution; a classification of its sources by subject-matter areas is proposed.

title: Digital Education in Modern Elderly People’s Lives
title_original: Digital Education in Modern Elderly People’s Lives
summary: The article examines the development of digital education for Russian older generation as one of the compo-nents of their lifestyle and as a social mechanism for reducing the digital exclusion. Digital education is ana-lyzed at three levels: access to devices and the Internet, the possession of digital knowledge and skills, and the ability to obtain real social benefits from employing them. It has been proven that digital education for older people cannot be reduced to one‑off computer literacy courses. It should include practical training accompa-nied by digital support, prevention of cyber fraud, reduction of anxiety, and preservation of the older user au-tonomy. It is emphasized that digital education is an integral part of modern older people’s lifestyle. Particular attention is paid to the local infrastructure of digital awareness: libraries, cultural centers, schools, social service centers, multi‑functional centers, NPOs, volunteer and veterans’ associations. The need for additional profes-sional education for the specialists working with older people is substantiated.

title: ПОСЛЕВУЗОВСКОЕ ОБРАЗОВАНИЕ, КАК МАРКЕР ХОРОШЕГО УНИВЕРСИТЕТА
title_original: ПОСЛЕВУЗОВСКОЕ ОБРАЗОВАНИЕ, КАК МАРКЕР ХОРОШЕГО УНИВЕРСИТЕТА
summary:
В данной статье рассмотрен вопрос послевузовского образования 
в университетах. Рассмотрена роль научных исследований в 
контексте университетов, как причина прогресса, способ обучения 
студентов во взаимодействии и формировании новых знаний. 
Рассмотрены препятствия в обучении студентов послевузовского 
образования и причины по которым они могут не завершить обучение. 
Собраны данные по университетам Казахстана о количестве 
студентов послевузовского образования (магистранты, докторанты, 
резиденты), с разбивкой по размерам, форме собственности, 
местонахождению университетов. Так из сорока четырех 
университетов, задействованных в данной статье, показатель доли 
студентов послевузовского образования был от 1,4 % до 28,2 %. При 
этом выявлены различия в этом показателе в зависимости от размера 
университета, а форма собственности не повлияла на показатель. 
Проведена сравнительная оценка доли студентов послевузовского 
образования в университетах Казахстана с этим показателем в 
университетах в других стран. Так наибольшая доля студентов 
послевузовского образования в Европе, в таких странах как Германия 
и Великобритания, в Казахстане этот показатель равен 8,2 %. 
Также отмечено что показатель доли студентов послевузовского 
образования недостаточно представлен в международных рейтингах 
университетов.
Ключевые слова: послевузовское образование, исследовательский 
университет, подготовка научных кадров, качество послевузовского 
образования, университет мирового класса.

title: Education and Social Transformation in Kyrgyzstan in Historical Perspective (Late 19th — Early 20th Centuries)
title_original: Education and Social Transformation in Kyrgyzstan in Historical Perspective (Late 19th — Early 20th Centuries)
summary: This article discusses the changes in educational institutions in the territory of the modern state of Kyrgyzstan in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, and their development in the context of imperial expansion, cultural changes and competing modernizing projects in Central Asia. It examines the relationship between the traditional Islamic educational system (maktabs and madrasas) and the new educational system of the Russian colonial administration and the Jadid reform movement. As part of their analysis, they studied the schools as institutions where knowledge, cultural values, and values of cultural and national identity were transmitted, where educational practices, public awareness, and the ideas about cultural and national identity were changed. The article examines the institutional characteristics and curricula of the various educational institutions, their social roles and the functions they play in the creation of the national intelligentsia. The study finds that traditional Muslim schools served as a key repository and means of perpetuating historical memory, the oral literary tradition, and the Arabic script. Meanwhile, the graduates of the Jadid schools were engaged in the process of education and cultural reform and in building national consciousness, while the graduates of the Russian native (Russian-Tuzem) schools were serving as intermediaries between the population and the administration of the Russian Empire and then the Soviet state. The analysis shows that during this period the educational environment was not a mere transitional stage but a complex field of interaction between various educational models, and the differences between tradition and modernization, local social initiatives and imperial educational policy. title: BIM education in the regions: programs, socio-economic problems and prospects
title_original: BIM education in the regions: programs, socio-economic problems and prospects
summary: The digital transformation of the construction industry has necessitated the training of specialists with competencies in building information modeling. In recent years, educational organizations in the regions have been actively implementing BIM technology training programs in the educational process. However, the development of BIM education is accompanied by a number of problems related to uneven resource provision, a shortage of qualified teachers, insufficient material and technical base, and differences in the level of interaction between educational institutions and employers. The article examines the experience of implementing BIM courses in construction universities and colleges in the regions, analyzes the main socio-economic factors affecting the quality of specialist training, and evaluates the compliance of educational programs with labor market requirements. Special attention is paid to successful employment practices of graduates with BIM competencies. Based on the analysis, the prospects for the development of BIM education in the regions have been identified and areas for improving educational programs have been proposed.

title: Влияние нейроморфной инженерии на образование, здравоохранение, генетику и селекцию для обеспечения технологического суверенитета и устойчивого развития экономики в эпоху когнитивных технологий
title_original: Влияние нейроморфной инженерии на образование, здравоохранение, генетику и селекцию для обеспечения технологического суверенитета и устойчивого развития экономики в эпоху когнитивных технологий
summary:
В статье проведено исследование особенностей влияния нейроморфной инженерии на образование, здравоохранение, генетику и селекцию для обеспечения технологического суверенитета и устойчивого развития экономики в эпоху когнитивных технологий. Нейроморфная инженерия оказывает многогранное влияние на социально‑экономические процессы, трансформируя ключевые сферы: образование, здравоохранение, генетику и селекцию. Показано, что целенаправленное развитие нейроморфной инженерии становится стратегическим драйвером прогресса, объединяющим научные прорывы с решением социально‑экономических задач в условиях глобальной конкуренции когнитивных технологий.
                  The article examines the impact of neuromorphic engineering on education, healthcare, genetics and breeding to ensure technological sovereignty and sustainable economic development in the era of cognitive technologies. Neuromorphic engineering has a multifaceted impact on socio‑economic processes, transforming key areas: education, healthcare, genetics and breeding. It is shown that the purposeful development of neuromorphic engineering is becoming a strategic driver of progress, combining scientific breakthroughs with solving socio‑economic problems in the context of global competition of cognitive technologies.

title: The Time Horizon: Tempodynamics as a Unified Ontology of the Time Field
title_original: The Time Horizon: Tempodynamics as a Unified Ontology of the Time Field
summary:
"Or perhaps water is time falling from the sky as rain? And soap bubbles are the Poincaré conjecture, which every child proves by seeing the round Sun in the sky? And we are all made of clots of the meaning of Time, and there is no need to prove Hodge?"... 

The work opens with a child's question and closes with a single ontology in
which time is primary, while space, mass, energy and thought are its
projections. Tempodynamics is not a new theory. It is a record of what has
always been.

This work presents an extended investigation of the tempodynamics model —
an ontology in which time is treated as a primary scalar field Φ(r), while
space, mass, energy, and thought are its projections. From a single axiom
on the identity of space and time through the gradient of the local
temporal rate, the Raum Theorem is introduced, together with four
fundamental equations that follow from it: the time-field potential,
gravity as a gradient, the metric of space, and the Poisson equation.

It is shown that all fundamental constants (π, e, φ, √2) are special cases
of a single accumulation series π(n+1) = 2π(n) − Θ(n), and that Euler's
identity e^(iπ) + 1 = 0 represents the formula of a complete rotation of
the time field. Three key ontological equations are derived:

    M = 4πR²ρ_τ          (mass as an integral of time density)
    G_μν = 8πG · T_μν     (gravity as the curvature of the time field)
    M_n = M_0 · n · π²   (a discrete mass spectrum)

Applications to the periodic table are considered, where the three
boundaries (92, 118, 137) are interpreted as the boundaries of survival,
excitability, and structure. The cosmological constant, dark energy, and
dark matter are likewise reconsidered within this framework.

The work is completed by a hermeneutic reading of the Emerald Tablet as an
operator model of the time field, and by a justification of the primacy of
time over space within the paradigm of contemporary physics.


/-KEY CONCLUSIONS ON HYDROGEN -/

The central quantitative result of the work is a complete derivation of
the hydrogen spectrum from the Rauma series.

It is shown that in the continuous limit the series
π(n+1) = 2π(n) − Θ(n) passes over into the discrete wave equation

    ∂²Φ/∂n² = λ∇²Φ + V(r)Φ,

which, in the Coulomb case, automatically coincides with the Schrödinger
equation for hydrogen. From the boundary conditions of the Coulomb problem
the spectrum structure E(n) ∝ −1/n² is derived, while the value 13.6 eV
is obtained by substituting the fundamental constants m_e, e, ħ, ε_0.
Thus the structure of the spectrum is derived and the scale is introduced
— an honest distinction fixed in the work.

The degeneracy in l is shown to follow from the additional symmetry of the
Coulomb potential, SO(4), and the time density in excited states exhibits
nodes and lobes — not a "probability cloud" but a structure of the time
field with phase boundaries. The Lyman series is reproduced to within 0%.

For molecular systems the wave line of tempodynamics gives quantitative
agreement with experiment:

    H       — 0%
    H₂⁺     — 0.4%   (LCAO + polarization)
    H₂      — 5%     (MO + configuration interaction)
    He      — 0.03%  (variational calculation with r₁₂ correlation)
    H (fine structure) — 0.7%
    H (Lamb shift)     — 24%

Chemical bonding in H₂ is shown to be a resonance of two atomic modes;
polarization is a deformation of the time mode; the r₁₂ correlation is an
interaction of two time gradients; configuration interaction is a mixing
of modes. Fine structure is interpreted as a resonance of orbital and spin
gradients; the Lamb shift as fluctuations of the time field.

It is explicitly fixed that the phase model (phase table, fitting of σ_0
and g) has no relation to the wave line — phases are postponed and used
only as classification.

Concluding result: hydrogen has given tempodynamics not merely a formula
but a boundary at which the wave line first becomes quantitative, and a
confirmation of the primacy of time: the structure of the 1/n² spectrum
is not a property of the atom but a property of the time field projected
onto the atom.


/-SINGULARITIES AND TIME-SIGN REVERSAL-/

Inside the event horizon of a black hole the sign in the gravitational
equation changes from minus to plus:

    ∇²Φ = −sign(τ(r)) · 4πGρ.

Beyond the horizon time flows backwards, gravity becomes repulsive, and
the black hole turns into a transition (a white hole) between two phases
of the time field. Formally this is described by a temporal phase shift

    ∇²Φ = −4πGρ · cos(Θ_phase),

where Θ_phase = 0 corresponds to normal time, Θ_phase = π to reversed
time, and Θ_phase = π/2 to the event horizon.

The superposition of singularities automatically leads to a reversal of
the sign of time: at total phase φ_total ≥ 255π a phase flip occurs
(τ → −τ), and at φ_total ≥ 512π the cycle closes (τ → τ′, a new cycle
at a new level). This means that black holes are not dead ends but gates
between phases of the time field, and the Universe is infinite not in
size but in cyclicity: beyond the threshold an inverse transformation
occurs into a reality similar to ours in its invariants, but with
different constants and a different direction of time. The law of
conservation of the time gradient turns out to be a special case valid
only in our phase of stabilization.


/-ON THE THREE QUESTIONS OF PARADIGM-/
Why does contemporary science follow the paradigm of the primacy of
space? Because it was born from the measurement of space. Arithmetic
measures numbers; geometry measures distances; astronomy measures
positions; mechanics measures displacements. Time in this paradigm is a
parameter — not measured directly, but inferred from motion in space.
Space is primary not because it is ontologically primary, but because it
is epistemologically primary. We began with it, and we remained within
it.

Why did this become entrenched? Because the theory of relativity
reinforced the paradigm. Einstein united space and time into a continuum
but did not make time primary. He equated them:

    ds² = c²dt² − dx² − dy² − dz².

The sign before dt² is positive, before dx² — negative. This is not
equality; it is asymmetry. But the asymmetry goes unnoticed, because the
habit of thinking spatially is stronger than mathematical precision.

Why did quantum mechanics not change this? Because it, too, works with
space. The wave function ψ(r, t) depends on space. Time, in it, is a
parameter. The Schrödinger equation

    iħ ∂ψ/∂t = Ĥψ

includes time as a derivative, but not as a field. Time has no dynamics
of its own. It is a background. Quantum mechanics does not refute the
primacy of time — it ignores it, because it works with space.

The result of these three questions: modern science began with space,
the theory of relativity absolutized it, and quantum mechanics did not
touch it. Space has remained an impenetrable frame through which we look
at the world. But if time is primary, then the frame is not a window —
it is a shadow. And a shadow can be shifted.


/-VERIFICATION BY REVERSE TRANSLATION-/

A methodological check was performed after the completion of the English
translation. The English text was translated back into Russian and
compared with the original Russian manuscript, in order to test the claim
made in the main text: "Translation is a loss of structure, not merely
of words."

The check showed that reverse translation does produce semantic
divergences, but they are not uniform. They fall into three classes:

    A. Terminological shifts  — 5–7 instances, moderate severity
    B. Lexical losses         — 4–6 instances, noticeable severity
    C. Structural shifts      — 2–3 instances, serious severity

In total, about 15 places where reverse translation would produce
divergences. The physical content is preserved at 100%. The terminology
loses nuances (clot, rupture, meaning, rate). The voice of the text
shifts from personal ("you") to neutral. The rhythm of key phrases is
softened.

This is precisely the phenomenon the work itself discusses. Here there
is no error — there is the fundamental limitation of language. Any
language is the language of a horizon. Any theory is the theory of a
horizon. Any formula is the formula of a horizon.

The English translation is another horizon. It is true within its
horizon. It is not complete relative to the Russian original. And
reverse translation exposes this.


/-THE HISTORICAL CASE: THE EMERALD TABLET THROUGH FOUR TRANSLATIONS-/
The same mechanism was tested on a concrete historical example: sentence
7 of the Emerald Tablet, nārun ṣārat arḍan — "Fire became earth."

    Arabic    — nārun ṣārat arḍan           — Fire became earth
    Latin     — Vis eius integra est, si     — Its force is whole,
                versa fuerit in terram          if it be turned into earth
    English   — Its force is whole, if it    — Its force is whole,
                be turned into earth            if it be turned into earth
    Russian   — Сила его цела, если          — Its force is whole,
                обратится в землю               if it be turned into earth

Three words became nine. Fire became force. A single event became a
conditional construction. The rhythm was lost. The sense shifted.

This is what the work speaks about: the error lies in the translation,
not in the original.

But the structure survived. The number 17 survived. The sequence of
steps survived. The binary character of the transitions survived. The
cycle survived.

Four languages, four horizons. One structure. And it has reached us —
because it is the time field itself.

title: Реализация права детей-мигрантов на образование в контексте обязательного тестирования на знание русского языка.
title_original: Реализация права детей-мигрантов на образование в контексте обязательного тестирования на знание русского языка.
summary:
В статье анализируется механизм реализации права детей-мигрантов на образование в контексте введения обязательного тестирования на знание русского языка. Авторы обращают внимание на то, что введение обязательного тестирования на знание русского языка как условия доступа детей-мигрантов к образованию порождает комплекс конституционно-правовых и практических проблем, и предлагают концептуальные подходы к совершенствованию законодательства, включая модель адаптивного доступа, при которой тестирование служит диагностическим инструментом, а не отборочным барьером.
                  The article analyzes the mechanism for realizing the right of migrant children to education in the context of the introduction of mandatory Russian language proficiency testing. The authors highlight that making mandatory Russian language testing a prerequisite for migrant children's access to education gives rise to a range of constitutional-legal and practical issues; they propose conceptual approaches to improving legislation, including a model of adaptive access in which testing serves as a diagnostic tool rather than a screening barrier.
abstract:
В статье анализируется механизм реализации права детей-мигрантов на образование в контексте введения обязательного тестирования на знание русского языка. Авторы обращают внимание на то, что введение обязательного тестирования на знание русского языка как условия доступа детей-мигрантов к образованию порождает комплекс конституционно-правовых и практических проблем, и предлагают концептуальные подходы к совершенствованию законодательства, включая модель адаптивного доступа, при которой тестирование служит диагностическим инструментом, а не отборочным барьером.
                  The article analyzes the mechanism for realizing the right of migrant children to education in the context of the introduction of mandatory Russian language proficiency testing. The authors highlight that making mandatory Russian language testing a prerequisite for migrant children's access to education gives rise to a range of constitutional-legal and practical issues; they propose conceptual approaches to improving legislation, including a model of adaptive access in which testing serves as a diagnostic tool rather than a screening barrier.
authors: А.В. Куракин, И.Р. Чернышова, Е.А. Суворова

title: Образование и наука в единстве и взаимодействии
title_original: Образование и наука в единстве и взаимодействии
summary:
В статье представлен обзор изменения динамики профессионального и высшего образования за последние 20 лет (2005–2025 годам) по России и округам страны (по данным Росстата). Отдельно проиллюстрированы данные по Москве и Санкт-Петербургу, городам, которые остаются безусловными центрами притяжения студентов. Также показаны тенденции изменения динамики профессионального и высшего образования по отдельным постсоветским странам, таким как Армения, Беларусь, Казахстан, Молдова. Приведено сравнение показателей численности студентов по различным образовательным программам по России, Федеральным округам, по Москве и Санкт-Петербургу. Представлена статистика по финансированию затрат на НИОКР, образованию в России и странах, которые лидируют в высокотехнологичных отраслях  экономики. Описан успешный опыт реформ в сфере образования в Казахстане — республике, которая столкнулась с проблемами в системе образования, как и все постсоветские страны, включаю и нашу страну, но поэтапно нашла подходы к их решению. Приведены государственные документы по поддержке науки, образования в России на период до 2030 года, в которых поставлена цель технологического развития страны, создания инновационной экономики, увеличения финансирования науки и образования.
                  This article presents an overview of changes in vocational and higher education over the past 20 years (2005-2025) in Russia and its federal districts (according to Rosstat). Data for Moscow and St. Petersburg, cities that remain undisputed student magnets, are separately illustrated. Trends in vocational and higher education dynamics in individual post-Soviet countries, such as Armenia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, and Moldova, are also shown. A comparison of student enrollment figures for various educational programs is provided across Russia, the Federal Districts, and Moscow and St. Petersburg. Statistics on R&D funding and education in Russia and countries leading in high-tech sectors are presented. The successful experience of education reform in Kazakhstan is described. Kazakhstan, a republic that, like all post-Soviet countries, including our own, faced challenges in its education system, but has gradually found approaches to address them. The article presents government documents on supporting science and education in Russia through 2030, which set the goal of promoting the country’s technological development, creating an innovative economy, and increasing funding for science and education.

title: Бизнес-образование как фактор технологического развития
title_original: Бизнес-образование как фактор технологического развития
summary:
Актуальность исследования обусловлена тем, что бизнес-образование в России существенным образом меняется в силу всеобъемлющей цифровизации, изменения кардинальным образом форм и содержания обучения, расширения практической ориентации, потребности в персонализированном подходе и изменения в расстановке геополитических сил. В данной статье предпринята попытка дать оценку перспективам развития бизнес-образования в России в условиях технологических, экономических, политических, других преобразований и санкционных ограничений. Ведущим подходом к исследованию является метод научного анализа, имеющий диагностико-прогностический характер, позволяющий комплексно рассмотреть факторы, сдерживающие потенциальное развитие бизнес — образования в нашей стране и определить наиболее перспективные его виды и формы. В статье представлен обзор наиболее существенных публикаций по исследованию рынка бизнес-образования, позволивший систематизировать факторы его развития, выявить неоднозначные аспекты, нуждающиеся в проработке, предложено соблюдение принципов «мозаики» и «сборки», а также такая форма и метод обучения, как интенсив на критические темы, отражающие принципиально новые вызовы и возможности рынка. Дана терминологическая трактовка словосочетанию «критическая тема», определены ее ключевые признаки. Обоснована необходимость постоянного мониторинга и диагностико–прогностического анализа с целью учёта не только текущих вызовов, но и долгосрочных изменений рынка бизнес образования. Материалы статьи могут быть интересны для образовательных организаций всех рангов и специализаций, аналитиков и предпринимателей.
                  The relevance of the research is due to the fact, that business education in Russia is rapidly changing due to comprehensive digitalization, changing training formats, increasing practical focus, the need for personalization and geopolitical shifts. In this regard, this article attempts to assess the prospects for the development of business education in Russia in the context of technological, economic, political, and other transformations and sanctions restrictions. The leading approach to the study of this issue is the method of scientific analysis, which has a diagnostic and prognostic character, which allows us to comprehensively consider the factors constraining the potential development of business education in our country and identify its most promising types and forms. The article provides an overview of the most significant publications on the study of the business education market, which made it possible to systematize the factors of its development and identify ambiguous aspects that need to be worked out., compliance with the principles of ‘‘mosaic’’ and ‘‘assembly’’ is justified, as well as such a form and method of teaching as intensive on critical topics reflecting fundamentally new challenges and market opportunities. A terminological interpretation of the phrase ‘‘critical topic’’ is given, and its key features are identified. The necessity of constant monitoring and diagnostic and predictive analysis is substantiated in order to take into account not only current challenges, but also long–term changes in the business education market. The materials of the article may be of interest to educational organizations of all ranks and specializations, analysts and entrepreneurs.

title: Доказательство научности верумики: принципы соответствия критериям научности с конкретными примерами
title_original: Доказательство научности верумики: принципы соответствия критериям научности с конкретными примерами
summary: В статье рассматривается соответствие концепции верумики ключевым критериям научности. Вместо строгого дедуктивного доказательства используется методологический анализ: для каждого критерия (Поппер, Лакатос, Мертон, Кун и др.) приводится формулировка, соответствие верумики, конкретный пример и ограничение. Ключевым элементом анализа является самореферентное подтверждение: верумика не только предсказывает наблюдаемые феномены (всеобщность антиверумизма, отсутствие верумики в истории, институциональная блокировка), но и объясняет их через собственный центральный механизм — принцип «лжецу — ложь».

title: Живое образование. Семя и развёртка новой педагогики
title_original: Живое образование. Семя и развёртка новой педагогики
summary:
Эта статья представляет собой концепцию или каркас нового взгляда на педагогику и образование. Современный мир находится в перманентном кризисе смыслов, и образование в этих условиях играет исключительную роль. Данная работа предлагает сменить градус восприятия и посмотреть на этот вопрос через призму законов мироздания. Также работа является одной из прикладных задач, решение которых предлагал метод фрактальной развертки, описанный в статье «Живое дыхание реальности». 

Эта статья — концепция живого образования, выведенная из законов мироздания. Современная школа дробит целостное восприятие ребёнка на изолированные дисциплины и выращивает фрагментарное мышление, удобное для старой системы, но беспомощное перед лицом её кризисов.

Работа предлагает сменить парадигму: не «передавать знания», а раскрывать потенциал. Не «учить предметам», а соединять их в ключи. В основе — предмет «Основы Мироздания», метод фрактальной развёртки и резонанс как главный орган восприятия. Ребёнок учится видеть целое — в музыке, в физике, в поэзии, в заповеди. И тогда он растёт не «винтиком», а творцом.

Работа — одна из прикладных задач, описанных в статье «Живое дыхание реальности» (DOI: 10.24108/preprints-3116518). Она показывает, как метод работает в педагогике и как его можно начать применять уже сейчас — через пилотные школы, один час в неделю, один ключ, одну связь.

При подготовке текста использовался генеративный ИИ (DeepSeek) для структурирования и редактуры. Автор несёт полную ответственность за содержание работы.

title: Factors of athletic achievement in sambo: psychological and social aspect
title_original: Factors of athletic achievement in sambo: psychological and social aspect
summary: Understanding psychological and social factors influencing athletic performance is crucial for enhancing athletes’ effectiveness. This study examines these factors in the context of sambo. The research involved 188 athletes of varying qualifications competing in the Russian Sambo Championship. For evaluation, psychological aspects included components of personal potential (meaningfulness, positivity, internalisation, inclusion, and independence), emotional responses to the results of the draw before the start, as well as persistent rituals and superstitions. Social factors comprised support from significant individuals (personal coaches, support groups, and psychologists) and the relative importance of recognition versus material rewards. The study found that the presence of coaches and support groups positively impacts sambo athletes’ results across skill levels, while psychologists’ roles were negligible. Stimuli preferences depend on qualification: most athletes prioritize material rewards, but for some categories of sambo athletes, recognition holds greater significance. Emotional reactions to the draw before competitions significantly affect performance regardless of skill level: confidence and calmness correlate with better results, while anxiety/stress hinder them. Rituals/superstitions vary in effectiveness by skill level – beneficial for some, counterproductive for others. Components of personal potential like meaningfulness and positivity positively influence performance, though their significance varies by athlete qualification. These results can inform individualized training programs tailored to athletes’ unique characteristics.

title: Formation of pedagogical principles of Olympic education
title_original: Formation of pedagogical principles of Olympic education
summary: The article is aimed at forming the pedagogical foundations of Olympic education in preschool education institutions, which is an important aspect for the development of children not only physical activity, but also values associated with the Olympic movement, such as the spirit of friendship, mutual respect and the desire for self-improvement. The main aspects of this process are considered, namely, the education of values associated with the Olympic spirit in children: respect for the opponent, honesty, justice, friendship, tolerance and team spirit. Attention is paid to the importance of instilling in children the ideas of harmonious development, learning the principles of a healthy lifestyle, and realizing the importance of physical activity for development and health. The origins of Olympic education in Greece, which contributed to the increase of self-respect in children through achievements in sports activities, the formation of the ability to work on oneself to experience victories and defeats, which have their roots in ancient Greece, are considered. It is revealed that by integrating Olympic themes into various educational areas: music, art, literature, it is possible to promote the development of children's creative and intellectual abilities.

summary: В последнее десятилетие в мире наблюдается резкое обострение противостояния между Россией и Западом во всех сферах деятельности, в том числе и в спорте. Авторы статьи рассматривают политизацию спорта как явление и проблему, исследуя взаимосвязь между спортом и политикой. По их мнению, в настоящее время спорт чаще всего стал использоваться в качестве инструмента внешней политики, который негативно воздействует на развитие международного спортивного движения.В статье проведен ретроспективный анализ деятельности международного олимпийского движения, начиная с первого учредительного конгресса Международного олимпийского комитета, который состоялся в 1894 году в Париже и по нынешнее время. Кроме того, рассмотрены актуальные аспекты политизации современного спорта, в направление которого против Российской Федерации были введены беспрецедентные по своему масштабу и интенсивности ограничения (санкции), препятствующие российским спортсменам участвовать в международных спортивных соревнованиях. In the last decade, the world has seen a sharp escalation of confrontation between Russia and the West in all spheres of activity, including sports. The authors of the article consider the politicization of sports as a phenomenon and a problem, exploring the relationship between sports and politics. In their opinion, at present, sports are most often used as an instrument of foreign policy, which negatively affects the development of the international sports movement.The article provides a retrospective analysis of the activities of the international Olympic movement, starting with the first founding congress of the International Olympic Committee, which took place in 1894 in Paris and up to the present time. In addition, the article examines current aspects of the politicization of modern sports, in the direction of which unprecedented in their scale and intensity restrictions (sanctions) were introduced against the Russian Federation, preventing Russian athletes from participating in international sports competitions.

title: Problems and prospects of training specialists in the field of tourism and hospitality in the context of the introduction of a new educational model in the Russian Federation
title_original: Problems and prospects of training specialists in the field of tourism and hospitality in the context of the introduction of a new educational model in the Russian Federation
summary: Introduction. In the context of intensive development of domestic tourism, as well as the introduction of a new educational model in the Russian Federation, it is relevant to consider the problem and prospects of training specialists in the field of tourism and hospitality. The problem of the research has been formulated, due to the discrepancy between the staffing and the declared development of national tourism projects. The materials and methods. The materials from the curricula of universities and colleges, as well as federal target programshave been used in the research. The following methods have been used: analysis and generalization of data from literary and Internet sources, content analysis, description and comparison. The research results. It has been revealed that the tourism and hospitality industry is experiencing a significant personnel shortage. Taking into account the introduction of a new educational model in the Russian Federation, it is necessary to ensure closer integration of higher and secondary vocational education in the field of tourism and hospitality. Discussion and conclusion. Modern problems and prospects for training specialists in the field of tourism and hospitality are currently due to the intensive development of national industry projects and the introduction of a new educational model in the Russian Federation. The process of training specialists in the field of tourism and hospitality in the context of the implementation of a new educational model in the Russian Federation must necessarily take into account the close integration of higher and secondary vocational education, as well as interaction with employers and their associations.

title_original: ВЗАИМОСВЯЗЬ СУБЪЕКТИВНОЙ ОЦЕНКИ И УРОВНЯ УДОВЛЕТВОРЕННОСТИ МЕЖЛИЧНОСТНЫМИ ОТНОШЕНИЯМИ В ВЫСОКОКВАЛИФИЦИРОВАННЫХ ТАНЦЕВАЛЬНЫХ ПАРАХ
summary: В статье рассматривается исследование аспектов субъективной оценки межличностных отношений танцоров-юношей и танцоров-девушек высокой квалификации в танцевальном спорте. В исследовании приняли участие 100 высококвалифицированных танцоров в возрасте от 18 до 25 лет включительно, с классами спортивного мастерства A/S/M по версии ФТСАРР и спортивными званиями МС (Мастер спорта) и разрядами КМС (Кандидат в мастера спорта) и I Взрослый. Для достижения поставленной цели были использованы психодиагно­стическая методика «Субъективная оценка межличностных отношений (СОМО)» С.В. Дух­новского и авторский модифицированный вариант опросника удовлетворенности браком. Статистическая обработка данных проводилась с применением методов математической и описательной статистики: критерий Шапиро-Уилка для определения принадлежности нор­мальности распределения полученных результатов генеральной совокупности, U-критерий Манна-Уитни для проверки значимости различий между двумя несвязанными выборками, ча­стотный анализ для расчет процентного распределения уровней выраженности параметров методики изучения субъективной оценки межличностных отношений, а также критерий ранговой корреляции Спирмена для расчета взаимосвязи параметров субъективной оценки и уровня удовлетворенности внутрипарными отношениями. Результаты проведенного иссле­дования показали, что у респондентов обеих половых групп по каждой из четырех шкал ис­пользуемой методики, а также по итоговой оценке, превалирующим уровнем субъективной оценки внутрипарных межличностных отношений выступил средний. Также имеют место половые различия в степенях выраженности различных компонентов субъективной оценки межличностных отношений на основании традиционных гендерных аспектов поведения. Кроме того, сильная взаимосвязь между субъективной оценкой и высоким уровнем удовлетво­ренности межличностными отношениями выявлена только по параметрам «Отчужден­ность в отношениях» и «Конфликтность в отношениях» в группе танцоров-девушек. В за­ключении представлены сферы применения полученных результатов проведенного исследова­ния для различных категорий участников танцевального процесса в рамках спортивного со­вершенствования танцевально-спортивных дуэтов в бальных танцах. The article examines the aspects of subjective assessment of interpersonal relations of highly qual­ified male and female dancers in dance sport. The study involved 100 highly qualified dancers aged 18 to 25 years, inclusive, with A/S/M skill classes and sports titles of MS (Master of Sports) and CMS (Candidate for Master of Sports) and 1st Adult. To achieve this goal, the psychodiagnostic methodol­ogy “Subjective assessment of interpersonal relations (SAIR)” by S.V. Dukhnovsky and the author's modified version of the marriage satisfaction questionnaire are used. Statistical data processing was carried out using mathematical and descriptive statistics methods: the Shapiro-Wilk criterion to de­termine whether the distribution of the results was normal in the general population, the Mann-Whit­ney U-test to check the significance of differences between two unrelated samples, frequency analysis to calculate the percentage distribution of severity levels of the parameters of the methodology for studying the subjective assessment of interpersonal relationships, as well as Spearman's rank correla­tion criterion for calculating the relationship between the parameters of subjective assessment and the level of satisfaction with intra-marital relations. The results of the study showed that among the respondents of both gender groups, according to each of the four scales of the methodology used, as well as according to the final assessment, the prevailing level of subjective assessment of intraparty interpersonal relationships was average. There are also gender differences in the severity of various components of the subjective assessment of interpersonal relationships based on traditional gender aspects of behavior. In addition, a strong relationship between subjective assessment and a high level of satisfaction with interpersonal relationships was revealed only by the parameters “Alienation in relationships” and “Conflict in relationships” in a group of female dancers. In conclusion, the scope of application of the obtained research results for various categories of participants in the dance process in the framework of sports improvement of dance and sports duets in ballroom dancing is presented.

title: Курашчиларда тезкор-динамик кучни баҳолашда замонавий ўлчов ускуналарининг самарадорлиги
title_original: Курашчиларда тезкор-динамик кучни баҳолашда замонавий ўлчов ускуналарининг самарадорлиги
summary: This article presents the results of a 3-month experiment on the development rate of strength types (maximum and explosive strength) in qualified belt wrestlers. The study utilized an electronic training device that provides rapid feedback on lifting and pressing the "opponent" (trainer frame). It was determined that the more forceful the downward pressure on the opponent, the more intense the upward lift can be. Notably, these strength types showed significant improvement in the experimental group (EG) that regularly engaged in specially designed exercises throughout the experiment.

title: The Forming and Development of Physical Culture and Sport in the City of Krasnoyarsk (XIX – beginning of XX centuries)
title_original: The Forming and Development of Physical Culture and Sport in the City of Krasnoyarsk (XIX – beginning of XX centuries)
summary: The purpose of this article is to analyze the development of pre-war physical education in Krasnoyarsk at the turn of the 20th century, compared with other provincial centers and major Siberian cities.A brief overview of the development of physical education and sports institutions in the Russian Empire is provided.The specific features of the Siberian region in terms of physical education and sports development are identified, and the dynamics of sports institutions' development in Krasnoyarsk are compared with those in other major Siberian cities.An explanation is given for the slower development of physical education and sports compared with other Siberian cities. Objectives: to identify the stages in the development of physical education and sports in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, to analyze the details of "Sokol" and the reasons for its demise.The study focuses on the city of Krasnoyarsk.The primary research method is comparative history.As a result of the analysis, the authors conclude that physical education was not very popular, as the majority of the population was already engaged in heavy physical labor.Moreover, the state was greatly afraid of revolutionary ideas and therefore discouraged any societies.But then the first gymnastics societies began to open.In Krasnoyarsk, it was called "Sokol".It was primarily associated with mass leisure activities and physical education.With the advent of Soviet power, all societies ceased to exist.Three stages in the development of pre-revolutionary physical education and sports can be distinguished in Siberia: before 1900 -the establishment of the first sports societies; 1900-1910 -a period of stagnation associated with the banning of various societies due to revolutionary sentiments; 1910-1914 -the heyday of sports life, the establishment of the first legal societies.In Krasnoyarsk itself, these processes proceeded more slowly than in Siberia as a whole due to its more eastern location, weak mountain biking, and a lack of qualified personnel.

title: Sports Diplomacy in BRICS: Opportunities for Russia’s Sports Sovereignty
title_original: Sports Diplomacy in BRICS: Opportunities for Russia’s Sports Sovereignty
summary: Amid the consolidation of polycentricity and the politicization of international sports, Russia, faced with unprecedented external pressure, is urgently seeking strategic opportunities to strengthen its sovereignty in this area. The article examines the role of the BRICS as a key actor in the formation of a transregional sports ecosystem. The authors propose a multi-layered model of sports sovereignty encompassing infrastructural, regulatory, promotional, and foreign policy aspects. Through the prism of this model, the evolution of the BRICS Games and the specifics of the participating countries’ sports diplomacy are analyzed. Particular attention is paid to the interests and actions of Russia, for which this format is becoming a tool for countering sanctions, promoting national sports, and strengthening soft power. The Games are viewed as a platform for the joint development of traditional and innovative disciplines, cultural branding, and the formation of alternative international norms. The conclusion substantiates the need for further institutionalization of sports cooperation within BRICS to strengthen the sovereign capabilities of Russia and its partners.

The conclusion substantiates the need for further institutionalization of sports cooperation within BRICS to strengthen the sovereign capabilities of Russia and its partners.

title: Influence of High-performance Sports on the Formation of Armenian Citizens’ National Identity in the Second Half of the 20th Century
title_original: Influence of High-performance Sports on the Formation of Armenian Citizens’ National Identity in the Second Half of the 20th Century
summary: The authors examine a little-studied scientific problem: the connection between the collective image of the future and sporting identity, which is based on the achievements of talented Armenian athletes such as Tigran Petrosyan (chess), Yuri Vardanyan (weightlifting), and Eduard Azaryan (gymnastics). It is shown that their successes, as well as those of the Ararat football club enhanced the Armenians’ national pride. The authors conclude that in the late 1980s, sport became a communicative mechanism for expressing national sentiment. In the context of Soviet reality, the achievements of Armenian athletes aroused a sense of pride among citizens and contributed to the increasing of national self-awareness, shaping a positive image of Armenia both within the USSR and internationally. The success stories of outstanding Armenian athletes, their performances on the international stage and at world championships, have become part of the nation’s cultural heritage. In the second half of the 20th century, high-performance sports in the Armenian SSR, serving as a means of social consolidation and a symbol of national pride for the Armenian people, influenced social processes in the multinational USSR, fostering a sense of local identity.

title: SPORTS DISCOURSE IN THE CONTEXT OF INTERCULTURAL COMMUNICATION AS A SOCIAL PRACTICE THAT CONSTRUCTS REALITY
title_original: SPORTS DISCOURSE IN THE CONTEXT OF INTERCULTURAL COMMUNICATION AS A SOCIAL PRACTICE THAT CONSTRUCTS REALITY
summary: The article is devoted to the analysis of linguistic, pragmatic and sociocultural features of sports discourse in the context of intercultural communication in the context of social reality. The authors explore how the language of sports, or sports discourse, functions as a universal means of global interaction, and at the same time is a carrier of specific cultural codes. The paper examines the role of sports terminology, metaphors and cliches, which, on the one hand, facilitate international, intercultural communication, and on the other, can create interlanguage, cultural and social barriers that prevent adequate transmission and receipt of necessary information. Special attention is paid to the strategies and tactics used by commentators, journalists, athletes, and others involved in physical education and sports to overcome cultural, linguistic, and social differences. It is emphasized that sports discourse serves as a powerful tool for the formation of collective identity and the transmission of fundamental values. The study demonstrates that successful intercultural communication in sports requires not only linguistic competence, but also a deep understanding of the socio-cultural context. In conclusion, it is concluded that sports discourse is an effective testing ground for the dialogue of cultures in modern conditions of globalization.

title: Integration of Sustainable Development Principles in Sports Industry: Standards, Initiatives and Ecological Responsibility
title_original: Integration of Sustainable Development Principles in Sports Industry: Standards, Initiatives and Ecological Responsibility
summary: Sports industry with global impact and numerous resources renders serious influence on the environment and society. The rise in event scale, increase in resource consumption and realization of global challenges, such as climate change, social inequality make systematic introduction of principles of sustainable development (SD) in sport extremely important. The goal of the research is to carry out all-round analysis of key mechanisms, initiatives and practices of SD integration principles in sports industry focusing on managerial standards, international programs and appraisal of ecological track. The article studies the link between concepts of corporate social responsibility (CSR), sustainable development and ecological, social and managerial aspects (ESG) in sports context. The research analyzed the role of international standard ISO 20121:2012 and key initiatives of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) (‘The Agenda for the 21st Century’, Rio-de-Janeiro and Bangkok declaration) in promoting SD. The authors systematized key types of negative ecological impact of sports industry and assessed their ties with the UN Goals of Sustainable Development (GSD) of the ecological cluster and conducted comparative analysis of CSR, SD and ESG concepts as managerial paradigms for sports organizations. A universal patter for elaborating strategies of sustainable development for sports events was worked out. In the research the authors used methods of systemic analysis (sport was considered as a complicated system), comparative-collative analysis (comparison of CSR, SD, ESG), benchmarking (comparison of concept characteristics), content analysis of international documents (standards, declarations, strategies) and classifications (systematization of impact types and their links with GSD), SWOT- and PEST-analyses of processes and events in sport. The research demonstrates progressing SD institutionalization in sport through introduction of standards (ISO 20121) and assuming of declarative responsibilities (IOC and others). Evolution from separate CSR programs to strategic integration of SD principles and further on to operationalization through ESG-approach was revealed that requires deep changes in business-models. All-round ties between ecological impact of sports (affecting mainly ecosystems of land) and widerange of GSD were identified, which underlines the necessity to prioritize measures of environment protection. The article substantiates the need to pass from spot initiatives to systemic management of sustainability at all levels of sports industry.

title: SWOT-АНАЛІЗ ІНФОРМАЦІЙНО-ОСВІТНЬОГО СЕРЕДОВИЩА В СИСТЕМІ ОЛІМПІЙСЬКОЇ ОСВІТИ
title_original: SWOT-АНАЛІЗ ІНФОРМАЦІЙНО-ОСВІТНЬОГО СЕРЕДОВИЩА В СИСТЕМІ ОЛІМПІЙСЬКОЇ ОСВІТИ
summary: Introduction. New approaches to the implementation of e-learning technologies in the Olympic education for professional training of physical education specialists have led to the building an informational-educative environment for e-learning of the Center for Olympic Research and Education.Aim is to substantiate the effectiveness of the model of informational-educative environment of e-learning of the International centre for Olympic studies and education of National University of Ukraine on Physical Education and Sport, based on SWOT-analysis. Material and methods: sociological methods (expert survey), SWOT-analysis and mathematical statistics. As a result of the expert survey (n = 17) the influence of SWOT-analysis factors on the informational-educative environment was substantiated, which allowed to determine the expediency and effectiveness of the e-learning in the Olympic education and its implementation in the International Center for Olympic Research and Education. Results. The study is based on a list of criteria adapted to the conditions of the educational process in physical education. According to the criteria selected by the experts, 29 factors identified as the strengths and weaknesses of the informational-educative environment of e-learning of the Center for Olympic Studies and Education, and 22 factors identified as the opportunities and threats of e-learning technologies in the Olympic education system. Conclusions. The use of sociological methods allowed to establish the existing ways of implementing e-learning technologies in the Olympic education system in Ukraine and the impact of SWOT-analysis factors on the informational-educative environment of e-learning at the International Center for Olympic Research and Education of National University of Ukraine on Physical Education and Sport.

title: Развитие современного музыкально-эстетического воспитания в китайских школах
title_original: Развитие современного музыкально-эстетического воспитания в китайских школах
summary: с начала 21 века процесс модернизации образования в Китае непрерывно ускоряется. Музыкально-эстетическое воспитание является важным элементом всестороннего развития личности, его роль в процессе школьного образования становится все более заметной, что в последующем превращается в ключевую опору в формировании здоровой личности подростков. Следует отметить, что музыкальное образование в качестве наиболее практичного и вдохновляющего средства эстетического воспитания, благодаря своему уникальному художественному воздействию, оказывает незаменимую функцию в развитии эстетического воспитания подростков, обогащении их духовного мира и повышении их общей культурной компетентности. В данной статье рассматривается развитие музыкально-эстетического воспитания в китайских школах с начала 21 века, анализируется повышение его значимости в рамках реформы учебных программ базового образования, а также подробно изучаются конкретные практические пути реализации этой функции в условиях новой эпохи. Исследование показывает, что эстетическая функция музыкального воспитания занимает центральное место в образовательных целях, что требует применения комплексного подхода, включающего инновации в стандартах учебных программ и оптимизацию педагогической практики, чтобы более эффективно удовлетворять потребности в формировании эстетической культуры у подростков. since the beginning of the 21st century, the process of modernising education in China has been accelerating continuously. Musical-aesthetic education is an important element of the all-round development of the individual, and its role in the process of school education is becoming increasingly prominent, subsequently becoming a key pillar in the formation of a healthy personality in adolescents. It should be noted that music education, as the most practical and inspiring means of aesthetic education, plays an irreplaceable role in the development of adolescents’ aesthetic education, the enrichment of their spiritual world and the enhancement of their overall cultural competence, thanks to its unique artistic impact. This article focuses on the development of musico-aesthetic education in Chinese schools since the beginning of the 21st century, analyses the growing importance of this field within the context of basic education curriculum reform, and examines in detail specific practical approaches to implementing this function in the new era. The study shows that the aesthetic function of music education occupies a central place in educational aims, which requires the application of a comprehensive approach, including innovations in curriculum standards and the optimisation of teaching practice, in order to more effectively meet the needs for the formation of aesthetic culture among adolescents.

title: Methodology for automated determination of shooting exercise results based on computer vision technologies
title_original: Methodology for automated determination of shooting exercise results based on computer vision technologies
summary: Relevance. The urgency of developing an automated method for rapidly and reliably determinining shooting results during sports competitions arises from the need to significantly reduce the time spent by sports referees on the results determination commission’s (RDC’s) process of analysing shot paper targets. This will help eliminate subjective errors and improve the overall quality and transparency of refereeing. Objective. To develop and implement digital technologies, particularly computer vision algorithms based on You Only Look Once (YOLO) neural networks, in order to automate the time-consuming and repetitive task of assessing the quality of shots and determining overall results at paper targets during large-scale sports shooting competitions. Methods. To achieve this goal, we used the following methods: theoretical analysis of scientific literature and regulatory framework on the stated issues; modeling of the target processing process; computer vision techniques (object detection in real-time based on the YOLOv11 neural network); geometric algorithmization for calculating the shooting results; and an experiment to test and verify the accuracy of the developed software in mobile device applications. Results. An original automated method for evaluating the results of sports shooting has been developed. The method is based on a novel algorithm that integrates a mobile platform, the Assistant RDC Android application, with the YOLOv11 model for detecting bullet holes of various calibers and a geometric model for unambiguous classification of the holes based on their size. This approach eliminates subjective errors in scoring and significantly improves the speed of evaluation of participants’ scores. Conclusion. The proposed digital transformation of the shooting sports refereeing system addresses significant drawbacks of the traditional system, which relies on visual inspection and manual calculation of target scores. The new system ensures consistent and reproducible accuracy, comparable to that of a skilled sports referee, while eliminating human error.

title: Бегуны на «аскетической звезде» П. Слотердайка. Часть I
title_original: Бегуны на «аскетической звезде» П. Слотердайка. Часть I
summary: Целью исследования является «спортивная» интерпретация непереведенной на русский язык книги немецкого философа Петера Слотердайка «Ты должен изменить свою жизнь. Об антропотехнике». Предмет изучения ‒ гуманистический (в терминологии П. Слотердайка ‒ "метанойический") потенциал стайерских беговых практик профессионалов и любителей. В соответствии с его концепцией "здорового аскетизма" бег рассматривается как укорененная в традиции антропотехника, перекидывающая мост от природы к культуре и обеспечивающая экзистенциально значимое вертикальное напряжение упражняющихся в рамках их индивидуальных возможностей на основе отстранения от габитуса ординарности. Обращение к идеям П. Слотердайка может способствовать популяризации беговых упражнений, целостно развивающих человека, и более глубокому пониманию ценности физкультурно-спортивной деятельности для устойчивого будущего. Методологической основой работы являются герменевтический метод, исторический метод, метод категоризации, дескриптивный метод, метод анализа. Героическое или даже божественное измерение бега отмечается с древних времен (Гераклит, Сократ, Платон). В возрожденном П. де Кубертеном Олимпийском движении наблюдается переход от символико-метафорической вертикализации бега (М. Экхарт, Н. Кузанский) к ее практическому воплощению как средству воспитания атлетов. Они формируются гуманизированным спортом и являются выразителями воплощенного в рекордах мирового уровня сверхчеловеческого начала. Идейную основу не нацеленного на рекорды, но способствующего личностной метанойи массового спорта П. Слотердайк усматривает в воззрениях Ф. Кафки, Л. Витгенштейна, М. Фуко. Выразителями такого рода спортивной деятельности являются полупрофессиональные бегуны, которые, систематически упражняясь, переходят от небольших дистанций к марафонам и сверхмарафонам. Современность П. Слотердайк характеризует как время упадка аскетического «вертикализма», в качестве подтачивающих его сил рассматривая экзистенциализм, витализм, консьюмеризм и туризм. Проявлением «антивертикализма» в беге ("метанойя за полцены") являются вошедшие в моду в 70-80 гг. прошлого столетия и актуальные до сих пор практики джоггинга – оздоровительного бега трусцой. Сегодня, убежден П. Слотердайк, ведущим основанием неравенства людей выступает их отношение к аскетическим практикам, которыми упражняющиеся отвечают на вызовы современности. Даже этическая компетентность личности усматривается немецким философом в интенсивности саморазвития, обязательно включающего в себя физкультурно-спортивные антропотехники.

Слотердайка может способствовать популяризации беговых упражнений, целостно развивающих человека, и более глубокому пониманию ценности физкультурно-спортивной деятельности для устойчивого будущего. Методологической основой работы являются герменевтический метод, исторический метод, метод категоризации, дескриптивный метод, метод анализа. Героическое или даже божественное измерение бега отмечается с древних времен (Гераклит, Сократ, Платон). В возрожденном П. де Кубертеном Олимпийском движении наблюдается переход от символико-метафорической вертикализации бега (М. Экхарт, Н. Кузанский) к ее практическому воплощению как средству воспитания атлетов. Они формируются гуманизированным спортом и являются выразителями воплощенного в рекордах мирового уровня сверхчеловеческого начала. Идейную основу не нацеленного на рекорды, но способствующего личностной метанойи массового спорта П. Слотердайк усматривает в воззрениях Ф. Кафки, Л. Витгенштейна, М. Фуко. Выразителями такого рода спортивной деятельности являются полупрофессиональные бегуны, которые, систематически упражняясь, переходят от небольших дистанций к марафонам и сверхмарафонам. Современность П. Слотердайк характеризует как время упадка аскетического «вертикализма», в качестве подтачивающих его сил рассматривая экзистенциализм, витализм, консьюмеризм и туризм. Проявлением «антивертикализма» в беге ("метанойя за полцены") являются вошедшие в моду в 70-80 гг. прошлого столетия и актуальные до сих пор практики джоггинга – оздоровительного бега трусцой. Сегодня, убежден П. Слотердайк, ведущим основанием неравенства людей выступает их отношение к аскетическим практикам, которыми упражняющиеся отвечают на вызовы современности. Даже этическая компетентность личности усматривается немецким философом в интенсивности саморазвития, обязательно включающего в себя физкультурно-спортивные антропотехники.
